title: Al-A'la 87:6-10 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-A'la, At-Tariq 1 to 8 and waqf
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 21 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-A'la 87:6-10 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 21. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ (٦) إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ (٧) وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ (٨) فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ (٩) سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ (١٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
And We will ease you toward ease.
So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Heavy laam of Allah; madd muttasil
4 counts on the alif, then a full Allah
Idgham with ghunnah: ن into ن

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-A'la 87:6-10 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 87:6-10 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 87:6-10 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Find the madd muttasil in 87:6 to 10.
Explain 87:9: why remind people, and when does reminding help?
questions.a: We remind people of Allah; it benefits those who fear Him and listen (87:9 to 10).
A) He who fears Allah. 87:10: 'He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.'

questions.q: Think again: Allah promised the Prophet ﷺ: 'We will make you recite, and you will not forget' (87:6). What helps us not to forget what we memorise?
questions.a: Daily revision, reciting in salah, du'a, and listening carefully; and Allah makes it easy (87:8).
